brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 to Draycott Green 230/34kV ahead of the heat event, as the unit's age and oil issue indicate reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress per MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period in accordance with MG-021. The supplied documents do not cover any specific override for ONAN cooling type beyond applying the general loading restrictions.
